title: Pirate Signal
prompt: drum n bass, uk garage, fred again, joy orbison, skrillex
description: Heavy amen break chops roll out at pirate-radio speed, sliced and reversed through shifting jungle edits while a deep sub bass punches beneath bright arpy stabs. The track peaks fast then deconstructs — stuttering amen fragments, dissolving stabs, raw as a '93 tape dub.
